label: modelled rupture plane (USGS finite fault)

notes.rupture: A USGS finite-fault model estimates the fault plane that slipped. The edge given is the plane's shallowest side, a model: not a crack mapped at the surface.
notes.point: Most earthquakes have no finite-fault model: USGS treats them as a point, and nothing is drawn.
